result.summary: Several visual and layout problems: a broken restaurant image, truncated restaurant name and category chips, and a large promo card cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image (or a proper fallback illustration) so the card matches the other restaurant listings.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is clipped by the tab bar, so most of the offer and restaurant details are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or scroll inset so the last card sits fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The last category chip (“Healthy”) is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Allow the chip row to scroll fully or add end padding so every label is fully visible.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” card title is truncated (“Trattoria Piccol”).
issues.suggestion: Give the card enough width or allow wrapping/ellipsis so the full restaurant name can be read.
